Don't expect it to last for more than a few strikes.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 10 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Rusty Claymore}} Rusty Claymores are two-handed [[Weapon]]s known for their low durability. They are commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[Eldin Canyon]], either abandoned or being used by [[Enemy|Enemies]]. They also have a chance of appearing in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn from scanning the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. If a Rusty Claymore is placed in front of a [[Rock Octorok]], it will inhale the sword and then spit out its cleaned counterpart.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} There is a 50% chance for a [[Traveler's Claymore]], a 35% for a [[Soldier's Claymore]], a 10% chance for a [[Knight's Claymore]], and a 5% chance for a [[Royal Claymore]]. Since they are made of metal, Rusty Claymores will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They are also unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune.
